label.administrable_evidence: The purpose of this NOFO is to build and sustain a more resilient public health system in Sierra Leone in an effort to identify, respond and mitigate health threats.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity aims to build and improve country capacity and leadership in health security, which aligns with the goal of investing in the capacity of partners to overcome health disparities.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The opportunity does not directly relate to any DMVA strategic plan objectives.
